summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that on June 9, 2026, the Contributing Shareholders (Grupo Aval, Banco de Bogotá, Banco de Occidente, and Banco Popular) transferred all of their 52.80% common shares in Corficolombiana via in-kind contributions at book value to Corporación Financiera Centroamericana (Ficentro). The transfer is an intra-group reorganization within the Aval Financial Conglomerate. Banco Popular remains the consolidating entity via a voting agreement. No premium, price, or outside consideration is specified. This is an internal restructuring, not a market-facing special situation. Watch for any subsequent regulatory or minority shareholder actions.
